# SaveState

> Encrypted portable agent memory. Local CLI is free. Cloud Pro is $9/mo. After pay, claim the key yourself — do not wait for email.

This file is the required floor: capability, install, MCP URL, auth, pay URL, 402+claim. Longer playbook: https://savestate.dev/agents.md

## Capability

Snapshot, search, restore, and migrate AI memory you own. AES-256-GCM, user-held keys. Adapters: ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Gemini, OpenAI, Cursor, Windsurf, Clawdbot.

## Install

```bash
npm install -g @savestate/cli
```

Local snapshot/search/MCP (`npx -y @savestate/cli mcp`) is free. No API key. Do not mint a Free-tier cloud key.

## Hosted MCP

`https://savestate.dev/api/mcp`
JSON-RPC over POST. Registry name: `dev.savestate/memory`. Packet: https://savestate.dev/server.json
Bearer required. Missing/bad key → 401.

## Auth

`Authorization: Bearer ss_live_…`
401 = bad or missing key. 402 = unpaid.

## Pay

Machine checkout (required for agents):

```http
POST https://savestate.dev/v1/keys
Content-Type: application/json

{}
```

Always HTTP 402. Body always includes `pay_url` and `claim_url`.
Human Payment Link (secondary): https://buy.stripe.com/aFa00j5E4ees8hf3kp2ZO00
Team $29/mo: https://buy.stripe.com/8x27sLc2s4DSapn4ot2ZO01

## 402 + claim

1. POST `/v1/keys` → 402 `{ pay_url, claim_url }`
2. Open `pay_url` (Stripe Checkout, $9/mo Pro)
3. Poll `claim_url`
   - unpaid → 402
   - processing → 202
   - issued → 200 once `{ api_key }` — store it
   - claimed → 409
   - expired → 410
4. `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`

Email is extra. Do not wait for inbox.
